[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility in Durant, Oklahoma is attributed to the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma, a federally recognized Native American tribe. Wikipedia coverage of the Choctaw Nation describes a tribal headquarters building in Durant that opened in June 2018, a five story, 500,000 square foot facility, alongside various tribal services including health clinics, wellness centers, community centers, and economic enterprises such as casinos, smoke shops, and truck stops, plus a printing operation and a document backup and archiving business, though no location, technical specification, or infrastructure detail for that archiving business or for any dedicated data center was found. This is very likely tribal government or enterprise IT infrastructure, potentially connected to the headquarters building or the document archiving business, but this was not confirmed in available sourcing this session.

reading: The Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma, a federally recognized Native American tribal government headquartered in Durant, Oklahoma, operates a data center in Bryan County supporting its own tribal government and enterprise IT operations. The Choctaw Nation is one of the largest tribal governments in the United States by citizenship and operates an extensive portfolio of government services, healthcare facilities, and business enterprises across southeastern Oklahoma, of which this data center is a supporting piece of internal infrastructure rather than a commercial colocation offering. Third-party data center trackers describe the facility only in general terms as small in scale, without publishing specific megawatt capacity, and no design or construction figures were available from the tribal government's own public materials as of the research date. As a tribal government entity, the Choctaw Nation does not file SEC disclosures or comparable public corporate filings, so this registry's confidence in facility-level specifics is lower than for publicly traded or well-covered private operators, and figures beyond location and general purpose are recorded as not published rather than estimated.
